text: ときに　ポケモンが　すすんで　つかってくれる　どうぐも　あるそうです。

structure.jp: ポケモンが　すすんで　つかってくれる
structure.en: that Pokémon will use of their own accord

structure.jp: どうぐも　あるそうです。
structure.en: there are also items, it's said

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (hearsay)
patterns.explanation: そうです after a plain verb says this is something heard from others. あるそうです = 'it's said there are'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれる after a verb says someone does it as a favour to you. つかってくれる = 'it kindly uses it for you'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: ポケモンが　すすんで　つかってくれる　どうぐ
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. ポケモンが　すすんで　つかってくれる　どうぐ = 'items that Pokémon use on their own for you'.
